methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches AI training program for workplace professionals - WDBJ7
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents peer-to-peer professional upskilling outside major metro areas, signaling potential for distributed deep capability if the training model spreads beyond a single institution to regional networks.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free community-led AI workshops targeting the technology gap indicate grassroots distributed learning emerging in Hampton Roads, though sustainability and depth of skill transfer remain uncertain without institutional backing.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's AI Ready RVA partnership concentrates institutional AI education resources in Richmond, potentially deepening metro capability but requiring intentional distribution mechanisms to avoid reinforcing the urban-rural divide.

signals.title: Left hand, right hand: Virginia cools on data centers even as state policy promotes the AI that requires them - Cardinal News
signals.signal_reading: Virginia's contradictory stance—promoting AI while cooling on required data center infrastructure—signals policy incoherence that could stall both concentrated excellence and distributed adoption, leaving the state in a capability vacuum.

signals.title: Appalachian Power sees ‘explosive’ growth from data centers, other big customers
signals.signal_reading: Appalachian Power's data center demand signals infrastructure concentration in historically underserved regions, but without parallel workforce development investments, this becomes extractive infrastructure rather than distributed capability building.
